label: H2 CfD (CHPS-style)
source: CHPS auction and JOGMEC CfD analogue
modelled_terms: Two-way hydrogen price-gap contract; $3.00/kg strike; 70% of hydrogen volume; modeled coverage 2030–2045
diligence_terms: reference hydrogen index and settlement formula; minimum/maximum volume and ramp; delivery point and quality; basis and price reopener; parent guarantee or letter of credit; termination compensation
notes: Residual 30% plus basis sigma 0.05; original volatility returns after tenor

label: Long-term PPA
modelled_terms: Fixed-price physical or financial PPA; $65/MWh; 60% of electricity volume; modeled coverage 2028–2043
diligence_terms: settlement node and hourly shape; balancing and curtailment allocation; renewable-attribute ownership and additionality; inflation and disruption reopener; parent guarantee or letter of credit; termination compensation
notes: Residual 40% plus basis sigma 0.03; spot exposure returns after tenor

label: CAPEX subsidy
source: GX transition bonds and 30% support analogue
modelled_terms: 30% support for eligible CAPEX; modeled as a construction-date CAPEX reduction
diligence_terms: eligible-cost definition; milestone disbursement; completion deadline; performance conditions; subsidy cumulation rule; clawback and change-in-control
notes: CAPEX level reduced 30%; capex volatility retained

label: Carbon reform commitment
modelled_terms: Policy support case; reallocates half of status-quo probability to binding carbon-price paths; modeled from 2027
diligence_terms: legal durability and implementation calendar; covered emissions; free-allocation phaseout; review and reopening rule; change-in-law allocation
notes: Policy support case; `value` = fraction of status-quo probability reallocated to binding carbon-price paths (0.5 = half). Was hardcoded as 0.5 in lib/interventions.reform_shift until the 2026-08-04 audit; now the only source. Modeled from 2027

label: Concessional finance
modelled_terms: Blended-finance case modeled at 150 bps below firm WACC; debt share and tenor follow the transaction profile
diligence_terms: facility amount and draw schedule; amortization and maturity; DSCR and reserve covenants; security package; distribution lock-up; prepayment and change-of-control
notes: Avoid joint use with capex support without a double-counting review

label: Naphtha/feedstock collar
source: Long-term feedstock collar screening assumption; replace with an actual index quote
modelled_terms: Fixed-price or two-way collar; $650/t reference; 70% of feedstock volume; modeled coverage 2028–2043
diligence_terms: reference grade and pricing index; delivery point and logistics; volume and yield basis; floor/cap settlement; price reopener; credit support; termination and replacement cost
notes: Residual 30% plus basis sigma 0.06; grade and yield basis need diligence

label: Circular-feedstock offtake
source: Long-term circular or bio-feedstock offtake screening assumption; DOE and IEA route anchor
modelled_terms: Fixed-price or collar offtake; $650/t reference; 65% of circular feedstock volume; modeled coverage 2029–2044
diligence_terms: eligible feedstock taxonomy and chain of custody; mass-balance accounting; quality and yield specifications; minimum volume and ramp; index and reopener; sustainability attributes; credit support and termination compensation
notes: Residual 35% plus basis sigma 0.08; taxonomy and mass-balance verification required

label: Integrated package
source: Route-applicable input contract plus PPA CAPEX support and carbon reform
modelled_terms: Route-applicable input contract + PPA + 30% CAPEX support + carbon-policy reform; concessional debt excluded to avoid double counting
diligence_terms: separate counterparty obligations; matched conditions precedent and long-stop dates; tenor alignment; subsidy and contract cumulation; cross-default limits; no double counting of support
notes: Concessional debt excluded; engine skips sector or route-inapplicable components
